shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n---FILES---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'markdown|editor|form' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' src/main.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@''^7.44.0 @gravity-ui/markdown-editor'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor MarkdownEditorView useMarkdownEditor && rg -n 'Required setup|MarkdownEditorView|useMarkdownEditor|onChange|value|initial' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -100 && cat package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | rg 'INDEX.md|README.md|\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor MarkdownEditorView useMarkdownEditor; rg -n 'Required setup|MarkdownEditorView|useMarkdownEditor|onChange|value|initial' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -100; cat package.json; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | rg 'INDEX.md|README.md|\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | sed -n '/\"peerDependencies\"/,/},/p'; rg -n 'YfmStaticView|RenderPreview|renderPreview|configure\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm | head -90; rg -n 'export.*configure|declare.*configure' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n* 2>/dev/null | head -30; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm | rg 'YfmStaticView|transform.*d.ts|index.d.ts"'$'"' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; sed -n '40,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md; npm ls --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,55p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/index.d.ts; rg -n 'initialEditorMode|initialSplitModeEnabled|splitMode\\??|initialContent|markup:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | head -60; npm view @diplodoc/transform@4.43.0 version"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '85,145p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; rg -n 'initialEditorMode|initialSplitModeEnabled|initialToolbarVisible|initialContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export type MarkdownEditorOptions|initial\\??:|initialMarkup|initialEditor|allowHTML' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | head -45; sed -n '150,225p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; rg -n 'configure\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @diplodoc/transform@''^4.43.0'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'declare function transform|function transform|export.*transform' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/types node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist 2>/dev/null | head -25; rg -n 'export.*Text|type TextProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg -n 'on\\(.change|\"change\"|change:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | sed -n '1,95p'; rg -n 'export default|declare function transform|function transform' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform --glob '*.d.ts' --glob '"'!**/*.map'"' | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'base-positive|line-positive|font-family-monospace|base-float|line-generic' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -40; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff -- package.json src/App.tsx src/App.css | head -220"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'positive-light|base-positive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs --glob '*.css' --glob '*.md' | head -25; sed -n '140,188p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md; rg -n 'MarkdownEditorSplitMode|type MarkdownEditorSplitMode|type MarkdownEditorMode' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})\"; git diff --check; git status --short; cat package.json | sed -n '1,28p'"
